events.title: Hillthorn Launches 10 November
events.summary: Hello detectives, We just announced at The MIX Fall Game Showcase that Hillthorn is coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch, iOS and Android on 10 November 2026! Hillthorn is a dark investigation game where you are hired to solve the case of a missing young woman from a remote and secretive mountain community. The story and your investigations unfold entirely through cards. Can you solve this case and discover what happened to Olivia? Wishlist Hillthorn and Play the Demo Now! https://store.steampowered

events.title: LudoNarraCon 2026
events.summary: Hello detectives, We are delighted to share that Hillthorn is an Official Selection for LudoNarraCon 2026! LudoNarraCon is an annual celebration of narrative games, the teams that make them and the fans who love them and we and excited to be included alongside so many incredible games. The event is live now until 15 October and includes a selection of demos and discounts that are well worth checking out: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon?tab=1 Wishlist Hillthorn and Play the Demo

events.title: Demo Update
events.summary: Hello Detectives!We released a demo update today that includes new content!New Content All cinematics have been redone New Zoom Feature available in options. When activated, you can now press on a card for small duration to show a fullscreen version of it. Entering a wrong path in the Winding Trails now has improved feedbacks. Improvement to the music in the first scene of the game. Bug Fixes Fixed resolution resetting when changing screen mode. Fixed cards being dragged out of the game’s screen

events.title: The Music of Hillthorn
events.summary: Hello detectives, We spoke to Antoine from Fool Moon Games about the music of Hillthorn. Q: How would you describe the music of Hillthorn? A: The music of Hillthorn is a mix of ambient analog synthesizers with carefully chosen acoustic instruments like tenor saxophone and female vocals. It has somewhat a vintage feel in many aspects, but also some modern effects and sounds to keep things diverse and surprising. Q: How important was the style of the music of Hillthorn? events.summary: Hello detectives, As you might have just seen during the Future Games Show we have some news! Not only can we now confirm that Hillthorn will be coming in November 2026, we can also share that alongside Steam Hillthorn will be launching on iOS, Android and Nintendo Switch. We’re so excited to share this news with you! Wishlist Hillthorn and Play the Demo Now!

events.title: The Art of Hillthorn
events.summary: Hello detectives, We caught up with Tara from Fool Moon Games to talk about the art direction of Hillthorn, the inspirations and considerations when creating a game with a story told entirely through cards. Q: How would you describe the art style of Hillthorn? A: Dramatic and stark. Q: Why did you choose this art style for the game? events.title: What is Hillthorn?
events.summary: Hello detectives, It’s been over a week since we revealed our new trailer, shared our partnership news with Raw Fury and released our updated demo. We have been so excited with the reception so far to Hillthorn! What is Hillthorn? Hillthorn is an eerie detective mystery set in a remote mountain community where it seems everyone has something to hide and you get the impression that outsiders aren’t as welcome as it might appear. events.title: Welcome to Hillthorn & Updated Demo
events.summary: Hello detectives, A young couple are missing; from the details you were provided when you were hired to find them it seems they were hiking somewhere remote and could have simply gotten lost... But there’s something about Mount Hillthorn and the people who live there that keep raising questions in your mind, too many unsettling questions... What has happened to this young couple, and do you have what it takes to find them? Hillthorn is an eerie detective game with an engaging and exciting story

events.title: The Mystery Begins... with a demo!
events.summary: A new case has landed on your desk. Another disappeareance. Probably a simple case, but time sensitive. Time to head to Hillthorn. To solve the case, you will have to combine clues, verbs and concepts to gather evidence. There's no prose or dialogue : Instead you'll have to use your intuition and imagination to uncover the mystery. Go on, give it a try! And don't forget to leave some feedback. Tick Tock, Investigator. Get more updatesBluesky Instagram
